objective: El estado de onboarding vive SOLO en Dexie: se retiran las claves legacy de localStorage.
dod: npx tsc -b && npx vitest run tests/onboardingSingleStoreGuard.test.ts tests/onboardingWriterGuard.test.ts tests/storageKeysAliveGuard.test.ts tests/onboardingService.test.ts --reporter=dot

invariant.statement: Referencias vivas a las claves legacy de onboarding (ONBOARDING_COMPLETED / ONBOARDING_STEP / flu-onboarding-completed / flu-onboarding-step) en src/: 16 -> 0.

metric.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const NL=String.fromCharCode(10);const walk=d=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?walk(path.join(d,e.name)):(/[.](ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs)$/.test(e.name)?[path.join(d,e.name)]:[]));let n=0;for(const f of walk('src')){for(const line of fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').split(NL)){const t=line.trim();if(t.startsWith('//')||t.startsWith('*')||t.startsWith('/*'))continue;const m=line.match(/ONBOARDING_COMPLETED|ONBOARDING_STEP|flu-onboarding-completed|flu-onboarding-step/g);if(m)n+=m.length;}}console.log(n)"
